newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +3.57 pct vs mark/dlr basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +3.57 pct vs mark/dlr basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 27.307 to the dollar after Tuesday's fixing at 27.194, and at 17.394 to the mark from 17.413.
The rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +3.57 percent, after a deviation of +3.64 on Tuesday.
At the time the central bank calculated today's fixing, the crown was trading on the interbank market at +3.58 percent.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT), and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated at 1130 CET.
